items.information: 🇧🇷 Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada. Mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SidesFortaleza2025/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Por favor leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição, bem como as [Orientações Adicionais](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/guidelines.html). Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a CMCE, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. --- 🇺🇸 Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance. More information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SidesFortaleza2025/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full) before the competition. By registering, you authorize ABRACM, CMCE, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

items.information: Join us for the LA leg of the West Coast Cubing Tour! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzA0OTYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--310605b25b0ecf790ae7a5eddc8b532d6493cd85/WCCT2.PNG) This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WCCTLosAngeles2025#43202-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1NKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--928aebc1c75f745abb0b80097896dba5180958fd/image.png) This competition will be streamed live on the [West Coast Cubing](https://www.youtube.com/@WestCoastCubing), [CubersLive](https://www.youtube.com/@Cubers-Live), and [SpeedCubeShop](https://www.youtube.com/@SpeedCubeShopOfficial) YouTube channels. ### UCLA Students If you are a UCLA Student or Faculty member, your registration fee for this competition will be waived. Register for the competition without paying, and contact the [organization team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=WCCTLosAngeles2025&contactRecipient=competition) with your credentials (such as a student ID) attached. Your registration will be accepted in the order in which this email is received.
